issue.title: Commit finalizer repair hardening after the sase-1h7/sase-1h8 failures
issue.description: Host-owned commit completion survives a conflict in a revision-pinned sibling, a conflict-repair turn that already ran `sase stitch create --resume`, and a paused rebase inherited from an earlier run, without stranding or falsely failing work. Finalizer-owned repair turns can no longer hand off and kill their own finalizer, and wait alerts say "can never self-resolve" only when that is true.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/finalizer_repair_hardening.md requests this work

issue.title: Revision-pin follow after the repair-handoff check
issue.description: pin-after-handoff: move the host revision_pin write for a conflict-repaired pinned sibling to after the repair-remaining handoff validates the main repo obligation, so the host's own pin write no longer trips "repository obligation changed after submit"; add the missing pin-plus-repair regression tests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/finalizer_repair_hardening.md defines phase pin-after-handoff as one work unit

issue.title: Conflict-repair resume never strands or falsely fails a commit
issue.description: repair-resume: make `sase stitch create --resume` publish an unpushed rebased HEAD instead of reporting "nothing to finish", and make the host conflict-repair path verify repository state (including ahead-of-upstream) when the repair turn already consumed the run-owned checkpoint.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/finalizer_repair_hardening.md defines phase repair-resume as one work unit

issue.title: Finalizer-owned turns refuse turn-ending handoffs
issue.description: owned-turn-handoffs: share the SASE_FINALIZER_OWNED_TURN guard that gate turns already use, refuse `sase monitor start` and the other turn-ending handoffs inside finalizer-owned turns, stop tool-run escalation from advertising a monitor join there, and stop a handoff from masking a failed finalizer as a completed run.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/finalizer_repair_hardening.md defines phase owned-turn-handoffs as one work unit

issue.title: No terminal wait alert for superseded session members
issue.description: wait-terminal-alerts: limit wait_checks terminal-blocker detection to members that are really terminal, so a failed monitor whose follow-up turn launched (or any member superseded by a newer one) no longer raises a false "Wait dependency can never self-resolve" notification.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/finalizer_repair_hardening.md defines phase wait-terminal-alerts as one work unit
